description: Returns the USCIS processing-time estimate for one form, eligibility category, and office: the time within which 80% of cases were completed, in months, weeks, or days. Use it when the user asks how long USCIS takes to decide a form. Pass form, category, and office exactly as the USCIS processing times tool lists them. Every estimate on file has both a category and an office, so omitting either returns not_found. For Visa Bulletin waits, use get_visa_bulletin. Requires sign-in at https://immigrationlayer.com/login and an active plan. Without a plan it returns subscription_required. Limit: 30 calls per minute per account, shared by all paid tools, then rate_limited. Not legal advice. Source: the USCIS processing times tool (egov.uscis.gov).

category.description: Eligibility category exactly as the USCIS processing times tool lists it, e.g. "Based on an approved asylum application [(a)(5)]" for I-765
category.example: Based on an approved asylum application [(a)(5)]

form.description: USCIS form number exactly as USCIS writes it, uppercase with the hyphen, e.g. "I-765". "i765" and "I765" do not match

office.description: USCIS office exactly as the processing times tool lists it, e.g. "Service Center Operations (SCOPS)", "National Benefits Center", or a field office such as "Houston TX"

name: get_processing_time

basis.description: What value measures, as USCIS states it

category_notes.description: USCIS's own note on the category, or null

unit.description: Unit of value as USCIS states it, e.g. "Months", "Weeks", or "Days"

title: Get processing time
